name: Husqvarna 545 / 545 Mark II
blurb: 13″–20″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ and .058″ gauge, 56–80 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: The 545 and 545 Mark II share one block in the guide, so both names are on this page. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 25 bar and chain combinations for the 545 / 545 Mark II: 13″, 16″, 18″, 20″. Pitch on those rows: .325″. Gauge: .050″ and .058″. More than one gauge is approved, so the groove stamped on the bar decides the chain. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 13″ setup with bar X-Force 596199756 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643656.
Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Force 596199766 and chain C33 X-Cut 585642266.
